h: North End and the top of Portsea Island
p: London Road is the main shopping street in North End, the busy area towards the top of Portsea Island, a couple of miles north of the city centre. It's lined with local shops, takeaways and cafés, and it's on the main bus routes in and out of Portsmouth.

If you're up this end, Hilsea Lines, the old ramparts along the north of the island, make a nice green walk, and Portsdown Hill, just over the water on the mainland, has great views over the whole city and harbour. Fort Nelson, home of the Royal Armouries' artillery collection, is up there too and free to visit.
